purpose: Successor Frontend V17 consumer-contract input reconciled to the latest Phase 4 Backend final-delta semantic decisions.

fcr_binding.binding_rule: The canonical R2 payload binds FCR identity/revision/status. The exact finalized DRAFT-02 file digest is bound by the R2 manifest after DRAFT-02 records the canonical R2 package hash, avoiding a mutual hash recursion.

shared_semantics.unknown_policy: Unknown schema, enum, identity, event, payload version, payload, cursor, or conflicting duplicate causes zero business mutation and zero cursor advance; retain at most a visibly stale last-valid projection and enter authoritative recovery.
frontend_allowed_derivations: event effect lookup from frozen table

contracts.name: GlobalRunCollectionProjection

RunCollectionItem: progress: {method:literal ACTUAL_TASK_MEAN_V1; completedTasks:integer>=0; totalTasks:integer>=0; fraction:number[0,1]; percent:number[0,100]}
activity: {eventId:string; type:string; sequence:integer>=1; timestamp:RFC3339UTC; taskId:string|null; messageCode:string} | null

contracts.availability: resultAvailability is mandatory; graphVersion is null only before actual graph exists; activity/start/completion/cursor nullable only as declared.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Any invalid item invalidates the response; a prior valid collection may remain only as visibly stale.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns all business fields and order/cursor. Shared adapter performs camel rename, immutable wrapping, total status mapping, and percent=fraction*100 only.

contracts.name: PreparedResearchDraft
contracts.availability: No planned Task/graph is returned; plannedGraphAvailability is explicit NOT_GENERATED until Confirm.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Expired, consumed, identity/hash/version mismatch, incremental input, or unknown schema fails explicitly.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns immutable draft facts. Template and FULL labels remain frontend display/form state and are absent from the normalized business DTO.

contracts.name: ConfirmRunResponseV1

OWNERSHIP_CHANGED: idempotencyReplayed is transport metadata and excluded from immutable admission

contracts.availability: Successful first response is 201/replayed false; exact replay is 200/replayed true with byte/semantic-identical admission. Conflicts return no admission.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Ambiguous outcome retries exact key/body. Same key with changed hash is CONFLICT; a new key cannot consume an already consumed draft.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns immutable admission and per-attempt ResponseMeta. Frontend may display replay diagnostics but replay never mutates business identity.

contracts.name: RunProjection

SEMANTICALLY_REPLACED: pathChanges are exact one-source Backend projections, never frontend event reconstructions

contracts.availability: Every review/result/artifact/proof/execution field is availability-wrapped; actual graph/version may be null only before creation; terminal fields are nullable only while nonterminal.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Torn watermark, identity mismatch, unknown status, sparse graph data, gap, or unsupported mutation rejects/pauses reduction and reloads one atomic snapshot.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns revision, sequence, graphs, fraction/counts/method and path changes. Adapter alone derives presentation percent and frozen effect mapping; reducer is sole live mutation point.

contracts.name: NormalizedRuntimeEventV1

fields: projectionRefreshRequired: boolean true exactly for REFRESH_PROJECTION or TERMINAL

ENUM_TIGHTENED: type: 55 raw values; 47 supported V1 and 8 explicit unsupported
OWNERSHIP_CHANGED: effect and projectionRefreshRequired are Backend-supplied or mechanically attached from the frozen table

runtime_inventory.event_effect_table_source: PHASE4_BACKEND_EVENT_CONTRACT_DRAFT.md sections 3 and 3.1 plus final manifest addenda

contracts.availability: graphVersion is always present, non-null for graph-semantic events and run.started, and otherwise nullable by the frozen event table; taskId is nullable only for Run-level families. Heartbeats are comments and not events.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unsupported/unknown type, payload, version, Run/Task, gap, order error, or conflicting duplicate causes zero mutation and cursor advance and snapshot recovery; exact duplicate is a no-op.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns raw event fact/version/payload. Transport validates. Shared adapter may attach exact effect/refresh values. Reducer applies only validated same-Run sequence.

contracts.name: ConnectionState

cursor_protocol.numeric: canonical 0|[1-9][0-9]* within signed 64-bit and <= Run tail
cursor_protocol.opaque: [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,256} exact eventId in the same Run
cursor_protocol.invalid_or_foreign: HTTP 400 INVALID_CURSOR SNAPSHOT_RELOAD before SSE headers
cursor_protocol.ahead: HTTP 409 CURSOR_AHEAD SNAPSHOT_RELOAD before SSE headers
cursor_protocol.terminal_equal: HTTP 200 SSE terminal headers, zero business/heartbeat frames, immediate close
cursor_protocol.architecture: atomic snapshot at N then fetch-stream strictly after N

contracts.availability: Only OPEN.lastHeartbeatAt is nullable; variant-specific fields exist only in their variant.
contracts.unknown_behavior: No clamp, replay-from-zero, Run switch, polling substitution, or terminal reconnect loop.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Frontend transport owns connection state only; Backend sequence/cursor identity is retained; it never becomes Run lifecycle authority.

contracts.name: FinancialReviewProjection

FinancialReviewCheckProjectionV1: correctionRefs:readonly {correctionId:string; runId:string; taskId:string; relation:literal ADDRESSES_CHECK; status:RESOLVED|FAILED|ESCALATED; resolvedAt:RFC3339UTC|null}[]

ENUM_TIGHTENED: verdict removes PASS_WITH_UNCERTAINTY and is exactly PASS|REVIEW|BLOCK|null; Check status, subject type, exception state, and correction status use only the final Backend vocabularies
RENAMED: Backend status -> frontend verdict by frozen rename
SEMANTICALLY_REPLACED: uncertainty and correction history are explicit Backend check/exception/correction facts, never a frontend verdict

identity_keys: canonicalRecordId and releasedResultId as an all-null or all-non-null pair
contracts.availability: If Review absent, review fields are null, arrays empty, and Availability explicit. Before Review PENDING; terminal-before-Review NOT_GENERATED. Half-null canonical/result is integrity failure.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown status/check schema or invalid subject/correction relation withholds Review. Aggregate review.resolved cannot manufacture check resolution.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns every Review/check/subject/expected/actual/exception/correction fact. Adapter only renames and wraps.

contracts.name: ClaimTraceProjection / TraceBundle

representation: claimAnchor:RepresentationClaimAnchor|null; non-null exactly when that representation anchor is available

NULLABILITY_CHANGED: all representation artifact/anchor IDs are nullable only for that unavailable representation
OWNERSHIP_CHANGED: primaryTaskId requires an explicit durable Backend primary relation; singleton cardinality never selects it

contracts.availability: Each missing detail/representation/anchor retains exact identity plus Availability. One format never borrows the other format's artifact or anchor.
contracts.unknown_behavior: No title/text/name/position/first/latest/metric/DOM/document fallback; any closure/hash failure withholds trace.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns relation and anchor manifest truth. Adapter preserves source order and exact camel rename. Frontend owns navigation/focus/scroll/highlight only.

contracts.name: ReportArtifactGroup

fields: anchorManifestId: string|null; required when group AVAILABLE
anchorManifestSha256: sha256 string|null; required when group AVAILABLE
ReportRepresentation: contentType: exact text/html; charset=utf-8 or application/pdf

ENUM_TIGHTENED: representations fixed exactly [HTML,PDF] with fixed requiredForRelease and contentType
NULLABILITY_CHANGED: artifact state table governs artifactId, safeFailureCode, attempt fields, sha256, sizeBytes, renderer, generatedAt, authorizedRef
OWNERSHIP_CHANGED: authorizedRef is Backend-projected non-bearer locator and never authorization
SEMANTICALLY_REPLACED: policy-skipped PDF uses availability.reasonCode PDF_NOT_GENERATED_BY_POLICY and safeFailureCode null

contracts.availability: Lifecycle is NOT_GENERATED->PENDING->AVAILABLE|FAILED; retry appends attempt and may FAILED->PENDING; AVAILABLE may later become UNAVAILABLE retaining immutable success metadata but no authorizedRef; terminal has no PENDING.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown policy/format/state, owner/hash/size/type mismatch, internal locator, or manifest mismatch fails closed; protected byte failures return zero bytes.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns slots, attempts, state, policies, manifest, bytes and locator projection. Adapter copies locator; every GET rechecks scope/identity/state/integrity.

contracts.name: ReleasedFinancialMetric

ENUM_TIGHTENED: proof.status follows total Backend Proof mapping; VALID is GENERATED_UNVERIFIED and never VERIFIED
SEMANTICALLY_REPLACED: proof object gains explicit policyId and current Backend proof semantics
OWNERSHIP_CHANGED: all method/technical/corporate fields and display values are Backend authority

contracts.capability_version_disposition: ABSENT_FROM_CURRENT_PUBLIC_RELEASED_METRIC_CONTRACT; capabilityId remains required. Adding capabilityVersion requires a later versioned contract.
contracts.availability: Method metadata and technical/corporate applicability fields may be null only under explicit Backend non-applicability semantics; limitations/guard refs remain present arrays.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown unit/period/actuality/proof/method/price/corporate state or broken lineage withholds metric and release; no recomputation or field dropping.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend is sole numeric, method, technical-price, corporate-action, Proof, and lineage authority. Adapter only renames/wraps; component concatenates supplied displayValue/displayUnit.

contracts.name: ReleasedObjectCoreProjection

SEMANTICALLY_REPLACED: latest release eligibility requires one ALLOWED ReleaseValidationRecord and complete Review/Proof/material-output/artifact closure

contracts.release_selector: Eligible RELEASED Runs only; maximum by releasedAt DESC then opaque runId DESC bytewise; empty is NOT_RELEASED/NO_RELEASED_RUN; sourceRunId equals latestReleasedRunId.
contracts.availability: No eligible release means the full release tuple and reportArtifacts null and metrics/claimRefs empty; available release requires complete non-null closure.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Partial tuple, invalid validation/policy/metric/artifact relation, or cross-Object Run withholds the slice; no latest arbitrary Run fallback.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns eligibility, order, release tuple, history and lossless members. Phase 5 memory/version/comparison/incremental/writeback remains absent.

contracts.name: ErrorEnvelope
contracts.availability: requestId/resource may be null only when safe context is absent; details is always allowlisted/redacted. Normal Phase 4A local requests do not emit reserved 401/403.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown/unsafe envelope becomes a local safe transport failure; no raw body or foreign-owner fact is exposed.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend owns code/HTTP/retry/recovery/message/context. Adapter validates and follows typed recovery; pages never reinterpret or render arbitrary raw details.

contracts.name: Availability
contracts.availability: PENDING only nonterminal; NOT_GENERATED means no attempt/record; FAILED means attempted and failed; UNAVAILABLE means retained known ref cannot be supplied; terminal resources never PENDING.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown/invariant failure rejects containing projection as SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE. Empty/null/HTTP200 never substitutes for Availability.
contracts.adapter_ownership: Backend projection owns every value; adapter only renames reason_code to reasonCode and UI enables retry only when supplied true.
